description.value: A small motel in the lakefront village of Fauquier, situated right off the Needles Ferry on Lower Arrow Lake. Originally built in 1968, it was fully renovated in 2016 by owners Ken and Liz Feiffer and now offers eleven air-conditioned rooms, five of which include kitchenettes. Its location on the ferry route makes it a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling through the Arrow Lakes corridor.

address.value: 101 Oak Street, Fauquier, British Columbia V0G 1K0
